name: dbgauss-glass-schemes-demo
description: Demonstration of scheme comparison for an 11-surface double Gauss laid out like the simulated backend's dbgauss model (stop on surface 6, F15 on surfaces 4 and 7, SK16 on 8 and 10): the baseline SCHOTT glasses, the nearest CDGM glasses and the nearest HOYA glasses (as listed by python -m codev_mcp.glass_near), each optimized with the same one-stage AUT spec; a fourth scheme changes the vignetting factors, whose error function values cannot be compared directly with the others. All values are demonstration values. AUT runs only with the real backend: use your own lens with the same surface layout and adapt surface numbers and values.

schemes.name: cdgm
schemes.reason: nearest CDGM glasses for F15 and SK16

schemes.name: hoya
schemes.reason: nearest HOYA glasses for F15 and SK16

schemes.name: vignetted
schemes.reason: baseline glasses with more vignetting at fields 2 and 3
